WITH periods AS (
  -- Q3 of the last completed fiscal year (FY2025/26) and the same quarter a year earlier
  SELECT calendar_date, fiscal_year FROM dim_date WHERE fiscal_quarter = 3 AND fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25','FY2025/26')
),
current_store AS (
  -- one row per store with today's region; stores comparable in both quarters only
  SELECT store_id, store_name, region FROM dim_store
  WHERE is_current AND store_id < 900 AND (open_date IS NULL OR open_date < DATE '2023-10-28')
),
sales AS (
  SELECT c.region, p.fiscal_year, sum(f.net_amount) AS amount
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN current_store c ON c.store_id = s.store_id JOIN periods p ON p.calendar_date = f.sale_date
  GROUP BY 1,2
),
refunds AS (
  SELECT c.region, p.fiscal_year, -sum(r.refund_net) AS amount
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
  JOIN current_store c ON c.store_id = s.store_id JOIN periods p ON p.calendar_date = r.return_date
  GROUP BY 1,2
),
net AS (
  SELECT region, fiscal_year, sum(amount) AS net_sales FROM (SELECT * FROM sales UNION ALL SELECT * FROM refunds) GROUP BY 1,2
)
SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 3 AS fiscal_quarter, cur.region,
       round((cur.net_sales / pri.net_sales - 1) * 100, 2) AS lfl_net_sales_growth_pct
FROM net cur JOIN net pri ON pri.region = cur.region AND pri.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
WHERE cur.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
ORDER BY cur.region

WITH periods AS (SELECT calendar_date, fiscal_year FROM dim_date WHERE fiscal_quarter = 3 AND fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25','FY2025/26')),
cs AS (SELECT store_id, region FROM dim_store WHERE is_current AND store_id < 900),
x AS (
 SELECT s.store_id, c.region, p.fiscal_year, f.net_amount AS v FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN cs c ON c.store_id=s.store_id JOIN periods p ON p.calendar_date=f.sale_date
 UNION ALL
 SELECT s.store_id, c.region, p.fiscal_year, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN cs c ON c.store_id=s.store_id JOIN periods p ON p.calendar_date=r.return_date),
t AS (SELECT region, fiscal_year,
  sum(v) FILTER (WHERE store_id NOT IN (136,137)) base,
  sum(v) FILTER (WHERE store_id NOT IN (136,137,129)) no129,
  sum(v) FILTER (WHERE store_id NOT IN (136,137,119)) no119,
  sum(v) FILTER (WHERE store_id NOT IN (136,137,119,129)) no119_129,
  sum(v) FILTER (WHERE store_id NOT IN (137)) with136,
  sum(v) AS all_stores FROM x GROUP BY 1,2)
SELECT c.region, round((c.base/p.base-1)*100,2) base, round((c.no129/p.no129-1)*100,2) no129, round((c.no119/p.no119-1)*100,2) no119, round((c.no119_129/p.no119_129-1)*100,2) no119_129, round((c.with136/p.with136-1)*100,2) with136, round((c.all_stores/p.all_stores-1)*100,2) all_stores, round(p.base,2) prior_net, round(c.base,2) cur_net
FROM t c JOIN t p ON p.region=c.region AND p.fiscal_year='FY2024/25' WHERE c.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' ORDER BY 1
